messages.author: 6af7adb6cf4ce340
messages.subject: RandomForest in java application
parts:
Dear Renjin users,

I'd like to use the randomForest library within the ScriptEngine.

      
 engine.eval('library(randomForest)");


However it returns

org.renjin.eval.EvalException: org.renjin.cran.randomForest.randomForest
    at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.ClasspathPackage.loadClass(ClasspathPackage.java:49)
    at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.Namespace.importDynamicLibrary(Namespace.java:179)
    at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.Namespace.initImports(Namespace.java:168)


My pom.xml integrates the following dependencies :


        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.renjin.cran</groupId>
            <artifactId>randomForest</artifactId>
            <version>4.6-12-b3</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
            <artifactId>renjin-script-engine</artifactId>
            <version>0.8.1615</version>
        </dependency>

Any ideas ?

Thanks in advance

Best regards


Erwan
